verdict: Lead costs are tracking on target for winter, but call volume and site conversion are soft spots.
diagnosis: Instagram delivered 115 leads at roughly $111 each this period, close to industry norms, while Google Business Profile calls dropped to 95.

signals.headline: 115 leads generated this period
signals.detail: Furnace campaign produced steady lead flow from $12,784 spend. Volume supports the fall heating push.

signals.headline: Cost per lead near $111
signals.detail: Sits inside the typical HVAC range for paid social. Acceptable for furnace season but worth tightening.

signals.headline: Only 95 phone calls booked
signals.detail: Direct calls from Google profile are the highest-converting channel. Volume looks low versus 239 direction requests.

signals.headline: 295 reviews, perfect 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is a genuine asset. Reviewers specifically praise technicians by name, which builds trust with new searchers.

signals.headline: Zero tracked purchases from ads
signals.detail: Pixel is not recording installs or bookings. Without revenue tracking, true return on ad spend is invisible.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Local Services Ads average $51 per lead with a 44% booking rate. Non-branded Google search averages $149. Meta lead ads typically land near $115, placing this account within range.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: Furnace repair searches climb 137% in January, and heating queries typically rise from September through winter. Demand for this campaign should strengthen over the next eight weeks.

competitor.label: CATEGORY
competitor.subheader: 76% of HVAC firms report rising demand
competitor.body: 91% of HVAC contractors are booked or nearly full this year, and 19% of homeowners plan a new system install. Competition for paid leads is heavy during this window.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads for furnace calls
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads average $51 per HVAC lead with 44% booking, well under current paid social cost. Worth running alongside Instagram this winter.

recommendations.title: Fix conversion tracking on the website
recommendations.detail: No purchases are being recorded against ad spend. Consider installing booking and call tracking so true return on each campaign becomes visible.

recommendations.title: Convert direction requests into booked calls
recommendations.detail: 239 people asked for directions but only 95 called. Test adding a click-to-call button and booking link on the Google profile.
